parameters.name: max_distinct_crops
parameters.description: Maximum number of distinct crop types allowed

parameters.name: ratio_rule_lhs
parameters.description: Left-hand crop index for each ratio rule

parameters.name: ratio_rule_rhs
parameters.description: Right-hand crop index for each ratio rule

parameters.name: ratio_rule_multiple
parameters.description: Required minimum acreage multiple for each ratio rule

variables.name: crop_selected
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if a crop is selected for planting, 0 otherwise

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit from the land allocation

constraints.name: nonnegative_acreage
constraints.description: Crop acreage must be nonnegative for each crop

constraints.name: binary_crop_selection
constraints.description: Crop selection indicator must be binary for each crop

constraints.name: total_land_limit
constraints.description: Total planted acreage across all crops cannot exceed available land

constraints.name: distinct_crop_limit
constraints.description: No more than K distinct crop types may be selected

constraints.name: selection_acreage_consistency
constraints.description: If a crop is selected then its acreage may be positive; if it is not selected, acreage must be zero. This is enforced by a linear upper bound using total land.

constraints.name: ratio_rule_minimum_multiple
constraints.description: For each ratio rule, the lhs crop must use at least the specified multiple of the rhs crop acreage

constraints.name: selection_acreage_consistency_big_m
constraints.description: If a crop is not selected, its acreage must be zero, enforced with a big-M upper bound using total available land

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: Define total profit as the sum of per-acre profits times allocated acreage.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit from the chosen crop allocation

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit from the chosen crop allocation; keep Z as a decision variable defined by the linear profit balance.
